title.narrative: Enhancing Climate Change Adaptation and Sustainable Energy Transition in Turkana County

description.narrative: The project seeks to enhance local climate change adaptation actions and access to sustainable energy in Turkana County through empowering women and other marginalized groups while fostering dialogue with power holders. The project also aims at building and strengthening grassroot movements that will advocate and lobby for just energy transition, sustained climate action while holding duty bearers accountable to realize climate justice among the marginalized and most vulnerable community members. At different levels, participatory research will be undertaken to understand drivers limiting local adaptation strategies taking into consideration the on-going initiatives such as the devolved climate financing, climate smart agriculture among others. Qualitative and quantitative approaches tailoring possible remedies to inefficiencies including development of software/app that would aid in early warning and weather information translation for decision making will inform next steps. In the case of influencing power dimensions for women representation and other marginalized groups taking up positions of leadership, sundry strategies will be devised during project inception phase and will explore dialogue with local leadership at ward, sub-county, county and national assembly’s levels including budgeting committees. These will include influencing existing legislations, leveraging on policy moments and processes as well as using local voices to articulate for equality/climate change justice and equity responsive policies, action plans, legislations etc. Community mobilizations will be key to ensure strong local movements through strategies that promote collaboration and shared value among communities, private and civil society organizations. Private sector collaborations in this case will be key towards realization of intended climate responsive actions such as weather-based insurance, provision of quality renewable energy products and fostering partnerships with the local community institutions and government to create sustainability.
